notes: In the bold poem font the sukun of the article's lam and the vowel of the following letter (in لم/لخ/لح/له ligatures) overlap into one glyph that looks like a damma; each case was checked at 2000-2400 dpi: circle + straight fatha stroke = sukun+fatha (e.g. الْخَيْرِ, الْمَحْيَا, الْمَوْجِ, الْمَشْيِ, الْمَرْضِيَّ, الْمَهْدِي, الْهَادِي, الْحَشْرِ), circle + damma = sukun+damma (الْمُهَجِ, الْمُنْتَسَجِ, الْخُلِقِ). الْهَرَجِ (p195) and الْحُسْنَا (p195) were read at 850 dpi only. اللهِ with printed kasra written اللَّهِ. Glosses on p196 use en-dashes written as '-'. Bayt numbers on pp193-195 printed as N) ; p196 as N-.
